clusters.headline: Heavy Rainfall Destroys Thousands Of Displacement Tents Across Gaza
aiSummaryBullets: Severe rainfall has destroyed thousands of makeshift shelters and tents throughout the Gaza Strip, including areas such as Deir al-Balah.
Local civil defense authorities have received over 1,500 emergency calls as families attempt to manage rising water and overflowing sewage.

clusters.headline: Severe Storms Inundate Over 70,000 Refugee Tents Across Gaza Strip
aiSummaryBullets: Winter storms in the eastern Mediterranean have caused widespread flooding throughout refugee camps in the Gaza Strip.
Local civil defense authorities have officially declared a state of maximum emergency due to the severe weather conditions.
